guides.title: Income certificate
guides.overview: Find the responsible official service for income certificate. Availability and requirements depend on the issuing authority.
steps: Choose your state or UT below and open its official government portal.
Find this certificate in Citizen Services, e-District, Revenue, municipal services or the responsible department. Check that it covers your district and purpose.
Read the service-specific eligibility and document list. Use the required Central or State format where specified.
Follow the authority’s online or counter submission instructions. Check the stated fee before paying and retain the acknowledgement.
Use the official reference number to track the application, respond to queries, and download or collect the certificate as instructed.

guides.title: Disability certificate / UDID
guides.overview: UDID provides a nationwide disability identification and certification platform.
eligibility: Indian citizens with one of the 21 disabilities recognized under the RPwD Act, 2016; a guardian may apply for a minor or someone unable to apply.
steps: Register at the official UDID portal and complete the application.
Contact the selected hospital’s UDID cell for a medical assessment date.
Attend assessment; the authorized hospital checks documents and issues certification through the system.
Track progress using the portal’s application-status service. A designated hospital can assist with offline access.

guides.title: Life certificate / Jeevan Pramaan
guides.overview: Jeevan Pramaan is an Aadhaar-based Digital Life Certificate for pensioners.
eligibility: The pension sanctioning authority must be onboarded. The FAQ excludes re-employed and remarried pensioners.
documents: Aadhaar or VID; name and mobile number
PPO number, pension account, bank, pension sanctioning and disbursing authority details
steps: Visit a Citizen Service Centre or pension disbursing office, or use the official application and its current authentication instructions.
Provide the required pension and identity information. At a centre, complete biometric authentication with the operator.
Keep the Pramaan ID sent by SMS after successful authentication. The certificate remains subject to authority approval.
Download the certificate and check acceptance on the official portal. Its validity follows the pension authority’s rules.
